run_deformable_detr_training: run the Deformable DETR model training on COCO dataset with configurable backbone and transformer hyperparameters
run_deformable_detr_evaluation: run evaluation of a trained Deformable DETR model on the COCO validation set using --eval flag
build_deformable_detr_model: build a Deformable DETR model with configurable encoder layers, decoder layers, and number of attention heads
resume_deformable_detr_training: resume Deformable DETR training from a saved checkpoint using the --resume argument with checkpoint path
configure_deformable_detr_args: configure Deformable DETR training arguments including learning rate, batch size, epochs, and loss coefficients
